reserves.name: Reverse repurchase agreements collateralized by U.S. Treasury securities

reserveReview.rationale: Deloitte's May examination reports $141.444 million of Treasury-collateralized reverse repurchase agreements and $15.589006 million of cash against $157.033006 million of reserve assets at May 31, 2026. Those amounts normalize to 90.07% repo and 9.93% cash.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Deloitte examination of the USA₮ Reserve Report as of May 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material asset-class exposure is unclassified; the report does not identify the repo counterparty, commercial banks, or custodian and sub-custodian used for the reported accounts.

providers.name: Major U.S. commercial banks (not individually disclosed)

sources.label: Tether USA₮ launch and reserve custody disclosure

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The report confirms segregated, unencumbered fiduciary trust accounts held for token holders and Tether identifies Cantor Fitzgerald as designated reserve custodian. The report does not name the commercial banks, repo counterparty, custodian or sub-custodian at account level, disclose provider shares, or establish a standing rehypothecation policy.
